messages:
maria: Heads-up — getting a flurry of customer escalations: hosted inference returning intermittent 5xx and timeouts since ~09:12 UTC. top affected endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Some reports include auth failures + billing errors. Can SRE take?

raj: I'm seeing a 3x spike in 502/504s on the eu-west gateway around 09:10-09:25. Error traces point to proxy timeouts to runtime pool.

leo: Confirmed high p99 latency on batcher -> runtime RPCs. KV cache hit-rate dropped from 68% -> 21% for affected models around the same window.

sarah: Customer-facing: multiple support tickets citing "request timed out" and "internal server error". I've escalated to AE team and added a temporary status page note.

maria: Repro steps from a customer curl they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"rwkv-7b","prompt":"hi"}' -v
> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\n> x-request-id: ix-0a2b3c\n> x-runtime: 00:00:02.345
```

leo: That x-runtime looks lower than the gateway timeout. Gateway timing out waiting for downstream. Pushing an adhoc dashboard for batcher queue sizes and runtime availability.

raj: Mitigation in progress: 1) Increasing gateway proxy timeout from 2s -> 6s for eu-west to reduce client 502s; 2) temporarily disable aggressive batching for the busiest endpoints; 3) divert traffic off a suspected overloaded runtime pool. Rolling now.

deploy-bot: deploy started by raj — config: gateway-timeout-eu-west bump, batcher-disable-eu-west (canary 10%).

zoe: Any customer regressions expected from longer timeouts? Product concern about cascading cost increases.

raj: We scoped canary to 10% traffic to limit cost. If metrics look stable in 10m we'll extend.

oliver: Observed an auth backend (token-introspect) saturation in eu-west around the same time — some requests returned 502 from auth proxy which surfaces as billing/auth errors to customers. I pushed a small throttle patch to token-introspect service to protect it.

leo: After canary changes: p50/p95 latency improved, 502s trending down. KV cache hit-rate recovering to ~55%. Still watching.

maria: Customer-facing update posted. Support will batch similar tickets and send a consolidated update.

raj: Post-mitigation actions:
- Roll back: none (we're leaving timeout bump live in eu-west canary -> extending).
- Short-term: increase auth backend capacity + add basic circuit-breaker in gateway to fail fast. owner: oliver, eta: EOD.
- Mid-term: improve KV cache autoscaling and add alert for sudden drop in hit-rate. owner: leo, eta: 2 weeks.
- Support: consolidate tickets and follow up with impacted customers. owner: maria/sarah, eta: 4 hours.

zoe: Also request: Product requests clear cost/runbook note before we permanently increase timeout default. Add to roadmap.

maria: Anything else? If no objections we'll close the war-room channel in 1.5h and open a postmortem doc.

raj: No objections. I'll capture logs and short timeline into the postmortem doc.

oliver: I'll scope the auth proxy scaling work and propose a circuit-breaker design doc tomorrow morning.

leo: Will tune batcher thresholds and add a dashboard alert for cache-hit dips.

maria: Thanks all — closing lock-step: 11:00 UTC check-in, then PM to own postmortem. :thumbsup:
